correction: A chmod of a directory that updex created must go through descriptors, not paths: O_NOFOLLOW protects only the last component, so reopening each created directory by its full path follows an ancestor that another process replaced with a symlink, and chmods an unrelated existing directory. mkdirAllMode creates each missing directory with mkdirat in its parent's descriptor, opens it with openat O_NOFOLLOW and fchmods that descriptor; a directory that another process created first (EEXIST) keeps its mode. A new directory is chmodded only when its parent is trusted (owned by updex's user or root, and not writable by group or others unless sticky), because a rename between mkdirat and openat in a parent others can write could swap in another directory; in an untrusted parent the directory keeps the umask-applied mode, which is never more open than the requested one.
